payload.title: Reject absent identity matches in dashboard proposal correlation
payload.summary: P2 read-only operator evidence integrity. details.turn_detail reports proposal_correlation=MATCH when stage proposal_id is absent and an archived Tool call has provider_call_id=None, because None equals None. A literal read_file response with no proposal identity reaches the actual RunDetail proposal_response_correlation display as MATCH. This is a false association in a maintained consumer, not proof of native editing, authority bypass or a real model invocation.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: through actual turn_detail/run_detail and served/detail projection, absent or empty stage/provider identifiers cannot establish a join. Cover both missing, only one missing, distinct nonempty IDs, genuinely matching nonempty IDs, read-only calls and supported legacy/partial records. Frontend must display NOT_ESTABLISHED for missing identity without inventing a link; preserve exact raw receipts and valid source references. Use the existing dashboard owner, not a new graph or Tool identity system.
payload.uncertainty: Independent deterministic temporary metadata reproduction; no model execution, actual subscription/billing claim, automatic approval or repair in this audit.
